name: Synchronous PTSO (PTSOsyn)
description: An operational x86-TSO persistency model with synchronous explicit persist operations and per-cache-line persistence buffers, developed as a developer-friendly reformulation of Raad et al.'s Px86, whose persists are asynchronous. Khyzha & Lahav prove PTSOsyn equivalent, in terms of reachable states, to Px86, so its crash-free consistency coincides with x86-TSO while persistency is governed by synchronous per-line persists that are closer to programmers' intuition.

catSupport.note: Presented operationally with per-cache-line persistence buffers, alongside a declarative characterisation — per-execution modulo the persist events cat does not have.
